findings.text: follow-on: the helper still sets serve._SERVER_CODE_STAMP with raising=False, a symbol this change deleted from reckon/serve.py, so the line is a silent no-op that guards nothing and can mislead a reader into thinking the refusal still reads that stamp.

item_verdicts.diff: read all three commits (212934296, 16372ca9a, d102a85e9) against 810e9a31; reckon/serve.py replaces the package-drift request check with the shared 30-second executed-definition report so both stamps derive from the report's own files, adds _CodeReload, and the test file adds four independent guards.
item_verdicts.done_when: the done_when names a test that changes a module on disk under a running server so a lazily imported name appears, asserts the server does not answer with an ImportError, and a negative control that reproduces the ImportError; tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py:180 implements exactly that pair, and repair-final-negative-control.log records the 500 cannot-import-name with the guard removed.
item_verdicts.goal: plan section 8 requires a long-running server either to reload onto one consistent revision when its code changes or to refuse with a named, visible stale-code error instead of a mid-request ImportError; reckon/serve.py:2398 _refuse_stale_code answers HTTP 503 error stale-code before any handler can lazily import, and _CodeReload at reckon/serve.py:1027 stops the listener, drains and re-execs.
item_verdicts.manifest: read; it records the base arm at 5 failed and the head arm at 1 failed with zero added failure ids, the four new guard tests green at head, and the guard-removal control red.
item_verdicts.write_paths: read the manifest's declared write paths; all three commits touch only reckon/serve.py, tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py and docs/evidence/fragments/a-page-load-reads-each-file-once/server-serves-one-code-version.html, every one inside the declared scope.

justifications.durability: tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py:93 fails if executed-code drift stops refusing the request, and the guard-removal control reddens the lazy-import case with a 500.
justifications.evidence: repair-base-suite.log and repair-final-head-suite.log each name the revision, tree and command they ran, and the head arm adds zero failure ids over the base arm.
justifications.fit: reckon/serve.py:991 routes requests and the status route through one served_code.served_report call in the codebase idiom, but tests/test_server_serves_one_code_version.py:72 still monkeypatches a symbol the change removed.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/serve.py:2398 refuses with HTTP 503 stale-code before the handler can lazily import, and _CodeReload at reckon/serve.py:1027 re-execs the process onto one revision, satisfying both arms of the section's done-when.
justifications.scope_discipline: the three commits touch only the two declared source/test paths and the evidence fragment, and carry nothing the section's goal does not imply.
